claims.reason: West_view.png elevation shows the F1 storey spanning y=400px(z=3.0m, F1 ceiling/F2 floor)=600px(z=0.0m, ground floor level), calibrated from the explicit '3000' mm dimension labels flanking that span. The cyan double-door frame (F1:D_west, west facade main double door) has its head/top cyan ink peak at y=440px and its sill/bottom cyan ink peak at y=561px (measured via view_pixel_profile on rgb(0,255,255), profile_001, candidates C01 peak=440 and C05 peak=561). This gives an observed door z-interval of about [0.585m,2.4m] above floor, i.e. a ~1.8m tall leaf mounted with an approx 0.6m sill/threshold zone, OR (more likely reading the small ~90mm gap between the bottom cyan frame ink and the floor hatch line as just a drawn threshold/line-weight artifact) an effective full door z=[0.0m,2.4m]. Either reading contradicts the candidate's current placeholder z=[0.0,2.1]; recorded here as located elevation evidence for future correction since the build/revise candidate budget (6) is exhausted in this run and this value could not be applied to geometry.
